Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
Yes—orders can be canceled within 3 hours of placing them, as long as they haven’t shipped yet. After 3 hours, the order typically moves into processing and can’t be canceled.
If you want, tell me your order number + the email you used at checkout and I can help you cancel it (if it’s still within that window).
